args.message: Average city revenue by region. North has the highest at 36444.92 across 3 cities, followed by South at 34756.63 (3 cities), East at 34369.35 (2 cities) and West at 24575.90 (2 cities). The group of orders with no known region averages 596.65. That group has two "cities": Paris (677.83) and a group with no city name (515.47), which covers orders whose customer is missing or has no city. Each city's revenue is the sum of its order amounts, and each city is defined by its name together with its region. All order statuses are included.
